sourceNote: Manually reconciled contract rows using NHL team announcements and PuckPedia season breakdowns. Signing-bonus fields are intentionally omitted from the simulation. Six additional 2026-27 contracts were reconciled against PuckPedia and club announcements on 2026-11-01. Signing bonuses are excluded from the simulation salary field; performance bonuses remain separately represented. Four additional Anaheim Ducks 2026-27 salary breakdowns reconciled against PuckPedia player contract pages and NHL/club announcements on 2026-11-02; base salary is kept separate from cap hit and signing bonuses are excluded. Eight additional Anaheim 2026-27 base salaries, cap hits and terms were reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns and NHL club announcements on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses are excluded from the salary field. Twelve Chicago Blackhawks 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Nine Detroit Red Wings 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Thirteen Edmonton Oilers 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Nine Florida Panthers 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Twelve New York Rangers 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Eight Washington Capitals 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Rémi Poirier held for affiliation reconciliation after his waiver claim. Three remaining cap-hit gaps (Patrick Kane, Andreas Englund, Bokondji Imama) reconciled against PuckPedia 2026-27 breakdowns. Twelve San Jose Sharks 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Two remaining New York Rangers cap-hit gaps (Noah Laba and Scott Morrow) reconciled against PuckPedia 2026-27 breakdowns. Libor Hajek 2026-27 base salary, minor salary and cap hit reconciled against PuckPedia. Rémi Poirier updated to Washington after the Nov 1, 2026 trade; 2026-27 base salary, AHL minors salary and cap hit sourced from PuckPedia. Eleven Calgary and Carolina 2026-27 base salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia, including correction of Jackson Blake and Seth Jarvis cap hits. Three Anaheim Ducks 2026-27 salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia. Nine Colorado Avalanche 2026-27 base salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia, including all roster gaps and the T.J. Hughes cap hit. Nine Dallas Stars 2026-27 base salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia, including signing-bonus distinctions for Lindell and Oettinger. Nine Montréal Canadiens 2026-27 base salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia, with signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Nine Pittsburgh Penguins 2026-27 salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia. Sidney Crosby and Erik Karlsson base salaries corrected to exclude signing bonuses. Nine Toronto Maple Leafs 2026-27 base salary and cap-hit records reconciled against PuckPedia, excluding signing bonuses from base salary.
